youtube_title: Robbed at Knifepoint: Fight or Hand It Over? Brave vs Normal #16 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL - WHO'S RIGHT? #16. Empty lane at night, a man shows a knife and asks for your phone and wallet. Brave wants to fight. Normal hands it over. Comment B or N!
Answer: NORMAL. Police advice is clear: don't resist. The robber wants your valuables, not you - things can be replaced, you can't. Remember his face, clothes and which way he went, get somewhere safe, call 112, then block your phone and cards.
Source: police robbery-safety advice (Arlington County Police).
